## Batch 60 complete

The pair now has 14 item carriers, two YAML-only pages, a synchronized manifest, proof contracts, coverage evidence, and 22 cross-batch dependency rows. The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library-aqft-20261023/physics/research/advanced-qft-supersymmetry-build-2026-10-23-batch-60.notes.md) record the source findings and remaining owner escalations.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (14 items, 44 steps), rendering (16 carriers/pages), dependency checks, precheck, strict contracts, content validation, coverage, and all 14 assigned dependency levels. Source retrieval reports 2/4 fetch-verified and 4/4 resolved; the two inaccessible sources remain documented drops.

Six items have current `ready` records; eight are `escalated`. The main unresolved proof is the real quaternionic monad-to-raw ADHM transformation, alongside Ward, GAGA, and family base-change inputs. The explicit counterexample rules out entrywise conjugation as that transformation.

Owner follow-up remains for the shared batch graph: batch 60 computes to level 2 with suppliers `[2, 5, 59]`, while stored state omits batch 2. Three escalated records retain older hashes after a metadata correction; I left them untouched because the workflow locks escalations against non-owner replacement. The run-wide checks also report seven stale levels in other batches and a stale pin for an out-of-scope mathematical original.
